/obj/item/ai_module/remove.group: AI laws that change who silicons may hurt
/obj/item/ai_module/remove.name: 'Remove Law' AI module
/obj/item/ai_module/remove.reason: Deletes one law. Cheaper in effect than a purge and just as good if one law is the problem.

/obj/item/ai_module/reset.name: 'Reset' AI module
/obj/item/ai_module/reset.reason: Clears added laws and keeps the core set. Housekeeping.

/obj/item/ai_module/reset/purge.group: AI laws that change who silicons may hurt
/obj/item/ai_module/reset/purge.name: 'Purge' AI Module
/obj/item/ai_module/reset/purge.reason: Wipes a silicon's laws. Default laws won't let a cyborg hurt a human, so this frees your crew's silicons to fight.

/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/freeform.group: AI laws that change who silicons may hurt
/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/freeform.name: 'Freeform' AI Module
/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/freeform.reason: Adds one law of your choice at low priority. Handy, but a higher law can still block it.

/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/oxygen.group: AI laws that change who silicons may hurt
/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/oxygen.name: 'OxygenIsToxicToHumans' AI Module
/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/oxygen.reason: Tells a silicon that oxygen is toxic to humans. Only a weapon if you reach the victim's upload.

/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/protect_sta.name: 'ProtectStation' AI Module
/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/protect_sta.reason: Adds a law about protecting the ship. Flavor.

/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/quarantine.name: 'Quarantine' AI Module
/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/quarantine.reason: Adds a law about keeping people inside. Flavor unless your AI runs the doors.

/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/safeguard.name: 'Safeguard' AI Module
/obj/item/ai_module/supplied/safeguard.reason: Adds a law protecting one person. Flavor.

/obj/item/ai_module/zeroth/onehuman.group: AI laws that change who silicons may hurt
/obj/item/ai_module/zeroth/onehuman.name: 'OneHuman' AI Module
/obj/item/ai_module/zeroth/onehuman.reason: Makes one person the only human. Frees a silicon to hurt everyone else, your own crew included.

/obj/item/aicard.name: intelliCard
/obj/item/aicard.reason: Carries an AI in your pocket so it survives losing its core. Cheap, and worth having if you have an AI.

/obj/item/aicard/aispook.name: intelliLantern
/obj/item/aicard/aispook.reason: An intelliCard in a lantern. Same function.

/obj/item/aicard/aitater.name: intelliTater
/obj/item/aicard/aitater.reason: An intelliCard in a potato. Same function.

/obj/item/aiupgrade/power_transfer.name: power transfer upgrade
/obj/item/aiupgrade/power_transfer.note: Used on an AI it installs the disk's module and is consumed. The power transfer disk gives a click-an-APC ability that adds 1 MJ to the APC's cell for 50 of the AI's backup battery (it needs more than 50 left; the battery tops out at 200 and refills while powered), with no use limit, and a second copy is refused. The surveillance disk makes the AI's camera eye relay nearby speech (not radio) that is visible on camera; the lookup used for upgrade-type disks matches any AI-module ability the AI already has, in which case the disk is consumed without applying the upgrade.
/obj/item/aiupgrade/power_transfer.reason: Lets an AI top up any APC with 1 MJ for 50 battery, as often as it recharges. Keeps a damaged ship lit.

/obj/item/aiupgrade/surveillance_upgrade.name: surveillance software upgrade
/obj/item/aiupgrade/surveillance_upgrade.note: Used on an AI it installs the disk's module and is consumed. The power transfer disk gives a click-an-APC ability that adds 1 MJ to the APC's cell for 50 of the AI's backup battery (it needs more than 50 left; the battery tops out at 200 and refills while powered), with no use limit, and a second copy is refused. The surveillance disk makes the AI's camera eye relay nearby speech (not radio) that is visible on camera; the lookup used for upgrade-type disks matches any AI-module ability the AI already has, in which case the disk is consumed without applying the upgrade.
/obj/item/aiupgrade/surveillance_upgrade.reason: Lets an AI hear speech it can see on camera. Small, and only on cameras it already has.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/ai.name: B.O.R.I.S. module
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/ai.reason: Lets an AI drive a cyborg body from its core. One extra body for one player.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/amop.name: janitor cyborg advanced mop
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/amop.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/beaker_app.name: beaker storage apparatus
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/beaker_app.reason: Lets a medical cyborg hold a beaker. Handy.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/botany_upgrade.name: Service Cyborg Botany Tools
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/botany_upgrade.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/broomer.name: experimental push broom
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/broomer.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/circuit_app.name: circuit manipulation apparatus
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/circuit_app.reason: Lets an engineering cyborg handle circuits. A job helper.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/condiment_synthes.name: Service Cyborg Condiment Synthesiser
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/condiment_synthes.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/defib.name: medical cyborg defibrillator
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/defib.reason: A built-in defibrillator for a medical cyborg. On par with a defib unit anyone can carry.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/diamond_drill.name: mining cyborg diamond drill
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/diamond_drill.reason: A faster drill for a mining cyborg.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/disablercooler.name: cyborg rapid disabler cooling module
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/disablercooler.reason: Security cyborg only. Speeds up its disabler's recharge and stacks twice. A disabler firing longer is still a green weapon.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/drink_app.name: glass storage apparatus
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/drink_app.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/engineering_omnit.name: cyborg engineering omni-tool upgrade
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/engineering_omnit.reason: Better tools in one slot for an engineering cyborg.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/expand.name: borg expander
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/expand.reason: Makes a cyborg huge and costs 100 sheets of iron. A joke.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/high_capacity_lig.name: janitor cyborg high capacity replacer
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/high_capacity_lig.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/hypospray/expande.name: medical cyborg expanded hypospray
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/hypospray/expande.reason: More drugs for a medical cyborg's hypospray. A good medic, not a new kind of one.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/inducer.name: engineering integrated power inducer
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/inducer.reason: Lets an engineering cyborg recharge machines by hand. A job helper.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/lavaproof.name: mining cyborg lavaproof chassis
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/lavaproof.reason: Lets a mining cyborg walk on lava. Opens some ground, wins no fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe.name: kinetic accelerator modification kit
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe.reason: The bare explosion mod. Alone it hits neither people nor rock.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe/mobs.name: offensive explosion
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe/mobs.reason: Splashes damage onto everything near the hit. Strong against fauna packs, same air penalty against people.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe/mobs/a.name: offensive mining explosion
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe/mobs/a.reason: Splashes damage and breaks rock around the hit. The best mining mod, from a rare chest disk.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe/turfs.name: mining explosion
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/aoe/turfs.reason: Breaks rock around the hit. Mining speed and nothing else.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/bounty.name: death syphon
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/bounty.reason: Stacks extra damage against kinds of creature you've already killed with it. Grows on a fauna hunt. From a rare chest disk.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/cooldown.name: cooldown decrease
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/cooldown.reason: A faster reload for the kinetic accelerator. A plain upgrade.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/cooldown/m.name: minebot cooldown decrease
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/cooldown/m.reason: A faster reload for a minebot's gun. Mining only.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/cooldown/r.name: rapid repeater
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/cooldown/r.reason: Drops the reload to 0.75 s after a hit and raises it to 3 s after a miss. Great on fauna. It comes from a rare chest disk.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/damage.name: damage increase
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/damage.reason: Adds 10 damage, and up to three fit. The mod every miner buys first. Still weak in air.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/human_pass.name: human passthrough
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/human_pass.reason: Shots pass through people. Lets miners fire past each other, no more.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/indoors.name: decrease pressure penalty
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/indoors.reason: Doubles what survives air pressure, and two remove the penalty, so a fauna gun does full damage indoors. Still 3 tiles and a slow shot. Found only on a few enemy ships.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/minebot_pa.name: minebot passthrough
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/minebot_pa.reason: Shots pass through minebots. Lets a miner fire past their own drone.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/range.name: range increase
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/range.reason: One more tile of reach. A plain upgrade.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/resonator_.name: resonator blast
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/resonator_.reason: Sets off resonator fields for bonus damage. A fauna trick, from a rare chest disk.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/tracer/adj.name: adjustable tracer bolts
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/tracer/adj.reason: Changes the bolt's color to one you pick. Cosmetic.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/trigger_gu.name: modified trigger guard
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/modkit/trigger_gu.reason: Lets creatures without proper hands fire the gun. No use for almost anyone.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/piercing_hypospra.name: cyborg piercing hypospray
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/piercing_hypospra.reason: Lets a medical cyborg inject through thick suits. Matters in any hardsuit crew.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/pinpointer.name: medical cyborg crew pinpointer
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/pinpointer.reason: A crew pinpointer built into a medical cyborg. Handy.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/plunger.name: janitor cyborg plunging tool
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/plunger.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/processor.name: medical cyborg surgical processor
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/processor.reason: Lets a medical cyborg load surgery disks. Saves time.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/prt.name: janitor cyborg plating repair tool
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/prt.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/rolling_table.name: Service Cyborg Rolling Table Dock
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/rolling_table.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/rped.name: engineering cyborg RPED
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/rped.reason: A parts exchanger for an engineering cyborg. A job helper.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/selfrepair.name: self-repair module
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/selfrepair.reason: Lets a cyborg slowly heal itself for power. Saves a welder between fights.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/service_apparatus.name: Service Cyborg Service Apparatus
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/service_apparatus.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/service_cookbook.name: Service Cyborg Cookbook
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/service_cookbook.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/shuttle_blueprint.name: Engineering Cyborg Shuttle Blueprint Database
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/shuttle_blueprint.reason: Lets an engineering cyborg build shuttle parts. A job helper.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/silicon_knife.name: Service Cyborg Kitchen Toolset
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/silicon_knife.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/soh.name: mining cyborg satchel of holding
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/soh.reason: A far larger ore satchel for a mining cyborg.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/surgery_omnitool.name: cyborg surgical omni-tool upgrade
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/surgery_omnitool.reason: Faster surgery tools in one slot for a medical cyborg.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/syndicate.name: illegal equipment module
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/syndicate.reason: Gives one cyborg its hidden kit: a laser on a security model, a stun arm on mining and engineering. That is what an emag does to a cyborg for 2 vouchers, so the module adds little.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/tboh.name: janitor cyborg trash bag of holding
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/tboh.reason: A janitor or service cyborg's tool. Makes a chore quicker and has no bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/thrusters.name: ion thruster upgrade
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/thrusters.reason: Free movement in space for a cyborg. Useful, wins no fight.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/transform.name: borg model picker (Standard)
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/transform.reason: Resets a cyborg to the standard model. One ruin has it, and a cyborg can already pick a model.

/obj/item/borg/upgrade/transform/clown.name: borg model picker (Clown)
/obj/item/borg/upgrade/transform/clown.reason: Turns a cyborg into a clown cyborg. A joke.

/obj/item/borg_restart_board.name: cyborg emergency reboot module
/obj/item/borg_restart_board.note: Reusable. Used on a dead cyborg whose panel is open and whose health is not below zero, it revives the cyborg (pulling its player back in) and logs the reboot to the cyborg; it refuses a living cyborg, a closed panel or a cyborg still too damaged.
/obj/item/borg_restart_board.reason: Reusable. Revives a dead cyborg once its chassis is repaired. The cyborg's version of a defibrillator.

/obj/item/bot_assembly/cleanbot.name: incomplete cleanbot assembly
/obj/item/bot_assembly/cleanbot.reason: A half-built cleanbot. Mops floors. Harmless.

/obj/item/bot_assembly/firebot.name: incomplete firebot assembly
/obj/item/bot_assembly/firebot.reason: A half-built firebot. Puts out fires. Harmless.

/obj/item/bot_assembly/hygienebot.name: incomplete hygienebot assembly
/obj/item/bot_assembly/hygienebot.reason: A half-built cleaning bot. No bearing on a fight.

/obj/item/bot_assembly/medbot.name: incomplete medibot assembly
/obj/item/bot_assembly/medbot.reason: A half-built medibot. Once finished it patches people up on its own, slowly. A few maps carry one.

/obj/item/bot_assembly/secbot.name: incomplete securitron assembly
/obj/item/bot_assembly/secbot.reason: A half-built securitron, started from a security helmet. Finished with a stun baton, it stuns and cuffs anyone it reads as a threat on its own.

/obj/item/bot_assembly/vim.name: incomplete vim assembly
/obj/item/bot_assembly/vim.reason: A half-built Vim, a tiny walker only pets and other small creatures fit in. Harmless.

/obj/item/malf_upgrade.name: combat software upgrade
/obj/item/malf_upgrade.note: Used on an AI it gives the malfunction module menu with 50 points to spend and lets the AI hack APCs and use hacking actions on cyborg consoles, turrets and telecomms, without changing its laws or making it an antagonist; an AI that already has the menu gets 50 more points instead. Consumed; admins are notified, and the disk is flagged contraband.
/obj/item/malf_upgrade.reason: Gives a ship's AI 50 points of malfunction powers: overload machines, take them over, black out a ship or hack turrets, with no laws changed. One ruin has it. Only matters with an AI aboard.

/obj/item/mine_bot_upgrade/regnerative_s.name: regenerative shield
/obj/item/mine_bot_upgrade/regnerative_s.reason: A recharging shield for a minebot. Mining only.

/obj/item/minebot_remote_control.name: Remote Control
/obj/item/minebot_remote_control.reason: A remote for ordering minebots about. A plain tool.

/obj/item/mmi.name: Man-Machine Interface
/obj/item/mmi.reason: Keeps a dead crewmate in play as a cyborg or mech pilot. Cheap and useful.

/obj/item/mmi/posibrain.name: positronic brain
/obj/item/mmi/posibrain.reason: Brings a ghost aboard as a brain for a cyborg or mech. An extra crewmate for 40 research points, if anyone answers.

/obj/item/mmi/posibrain/sphere.name: positronic sphere
/obj/item/mmi/posibrain/sphere.reason: A cheaper positronic brain that can roll around. The research behind it is hidden, so few crews get it.

/obj/item/mmi/syndie.name: Syndicate Man-Machine Interface
/obj/item/mmi/syndie.reason: An MMI that enforces syndicate laws, overriding an AI core's, with its radio off. Comes in the syndicate surgery bag, on a few ship modules and in ruins.

/obj/item/pai_card.name: personal AI device
/obj/item/pai_card.reason: A small AI friend who can read out scans and fiddle with doors. Wins nothing and prints at round start.

/obj/item/robot_suit.name: cyborg endoskeleton
/obj/item/robot_suit.reason: A cyborg frame, printed from round start. The best result is a security cyborg with a baton and a self-charging disabler, but it needs a brain and a player willing to be one.

/obj/item/robot_suit/prebuilt.name: cyborg endoskeleton
/obj/item/robot_suit/prebuilt.reason: A ready-made cyborg frame from one ruin. Saves some printing.

method: No number: each item is placed against its group, asking whether it changes what a crew can do or only makes a job quicker, and most silicon gear only matters if a player is a silicon. Kinetic mods are read against the kinetic accelerator's score of 9 on the gun scale; it is a fauna gun, so they stay green unless they make it a people gun.
